newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open 0.05 higher.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open 0.05 higher.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures were called to open 0.05 cent firmer Monday, dealers said.
Friday, March closed at 10.45 cents a lb, up 0.06, traded 10.54 to 10.42 cents. The back months settled up 0.01 to off 0.01.
Despite closing firmer, prices slid off the highs and ended below former resistance at 10.47 to 10.50 basis March.
Nearby support was seen at a gap on the charts formed Friday, between 10.44 and 10.42, in March.

LIFFE white sugar futures were slightly higher in early trade Monday. The spot March contarct was trading $0.70 higher at $301.00, and the back months were unchanged to $1.20 firmer, at 0846 EST/1346 GMT.
